acceptanceCriteria: corvint_expand with a null or missing index returns a typed refusal, covered by a test
the Pi adapter version is bumped together with the schema change
body:
Found during V1-0448 (item 5, lsp-editor-pi batch lane, 2026-10-21). Pi's Value.Convert turns a null corvint_expand index into 0 (integrations/pi/tools.js), so a malformed request expands the first result instead of being refused. A fix changes the tool schema the model sees and needs a Pi adapter version bump (0.3.3).
Expected: a null or missing index is refused with a typed error.

title: Pi corvint_expand: a null index is coerced to 0 and silently expands result 0
